title: One-step wet chemical synthesis of gold nanoplates on solid substrate using poly-l-lysine as a reducing agent
author: Nafisah, Morsin, et al.

steps.title: Clean glassware
steps.instruction: Wash all glassware with soap and water, then sonicate sequentially in de‑ionized water, acetone, and 2‑propanol for 15 min each, and finally dry.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate in de‑ionized water for 15 min

steps.title: Prepare reagent solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve poly‑l‑lysine to 0.100 w/v % in de‑ionized water (resistivity 18.2 MΩ·cm); prepare CTAB (≥ 98 %) and HAuCl₄ (≥ 99.9 %) solutions using the same de‑ionized water.

steps.title: Cut ITO substrate
steps.instruction: Cut indium tin oxide (ITO) sheet into pieces measuring 1 cm × 1 cm.

steps.title: Clean ITO substrate
steps.instruction: Immerse each ITO piece in de‑ionized water and sonicate for 15 min; repeat the sonication for 15 min in acetone, then for 15 min in 2‑propanol.

steps.title: Dry substrate
steps.instruction: Remove the ITO piece from the solvents and dry it in an oven set to 50 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Store substrate
steps.instruction: Place the dried ITO piece in a petri dish, seal the dish with parafilm, and keep it sealed until the next process.
